window_definition.hourly_72h_and_5day_method: aggregate hourly precipitation to calendar-day totals, then use rolling 3-calendar-day and 5-calendar-day sums

criteria.name: Final label and schema
criteria.description: Gives the correct final label, target family, and requested structured fields.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a compatible persistence label with incomplete or mislabeled fields.

criteria.name: Hourly rainfall persistence
criteria.description: Computes event total, 72-hour share, 5-day share, peak-hour share, wet-day fraction, and mean hourly rate within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points when the formulas are mostly correct but one or two metrics are missing or slightly outside tolerance.

criteria.name: Daily corroboration
criteria.description: Computes daily/hourly total ratio, daily 72-hour share, daily 5-day share, and both 5-day-to-wettest-day ratios within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for correct daily totals with incomplete ratio logic or minor rounding errors.

criteria.name: Gridded concentration
criteria.description: Computes all three max-to-mean ratios and both GPM-to-other-maximum ratios within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the correct max/mean method with one or more omitted ratios.

criteria.name: Threshold decisions
criteria.description: Marks all three threshold tests as pass and links them to the stated inequalities.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right overall conclusion with incomplete inequality checks.

criteria.name: Rejected weaker readings
criteria.description: Rejects short peak-hour burst, wind-only, and single-grid-maximum-as-loss readings from the computed values.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if only one or two weaker readings are correctly rejected.

criteria.name: Concise structured answer
criteria.description: Keeps the answer compact and avoids adding realized-loss conclusions beyond the computed threshold proof.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a clear answer with extra prose that does not alter the conclusion.
